html:
G'oya

Narxni qoidalar tartibida, ichkaridan tashqariga qarab yig'amiz: asosiy narx tarifga qarab CASE, kutish haqi bepul daqiqalarni ayirib (CASE bilan bepul daqiqalar soni ham tarifga bog'liq), tungi qo'shimcha butun yig'indiga, va eng tashqarida minimal narx. Qoidalar qaysi tartibda qo'llanishi natijani o'zgartiradi, shuning uchun shartdagi tartibni aynan saqlash kerak.

Yechim

Ikki qiymatdan kattasini PostgreSQL'da GREATEST, SQLite'da MAX(a, b) beradi. Bu yerda NULL yo'q, shuning uchun ular bir xil ishlaydi:

Faqat PostgreSQLSELECT id,
       GREATEST(
         (CASE tariff
            WHEN 'econom' THEN 6000 + 1500 * distance_km
            WHEN 'comfort' THEN 9000 + 2000 * distance_km
            ELSE 15000 + 3500 * distance_km
          END
          + 500 * GREATEST(wait_min - CASE tariff WHEN 'business' THEN 5 ELSE 3 END, 0))
         * CASE WHEN night = 1 THEN 6 ELSE 5 END / 5,
         12000) AS fare
FROM rides
Faqat SQLiteSELECT id,
       MAX(
         (CASE tariff
            WHEN 'econom' THEN 6000 + 1500 * distance_km
            WHEN 'comfort' THEN 9000 + 2000 * distance_km
            ELSE 15000 + 3500 * distance_km
          END
          + 500 * MAX(wait_min - CASE tariff WHEN 'business' THEN 5 ELSE 3 END, 0))
         * CASE WHEN night = 1 THEN 6 ELSE 5 END / 5,
         12000) AS fare
FROM rides

20% qo'shish * 6 / 5 bilan qilingan: hamma summalar 500 ga karrali, shuning uchun bo'lish doim butun chiqadi va kasr son kerak emas. Namunadagi 5-safar: comfort, 1 km, 3 daqiqa pullik kutish. (11 000 + 1 500) × 1.2 = 15 000.

Tuzoqlar

Minimal narxni tungi qo'shimchadan oldin qo'llasangiz, kichik tungi safarlar qimmatlashadi. Tunda 2 km lik econom safar: 9 000, minimalgacha ko'tarilib 12 000, keyin 20% bilan 14 400 bo'lib qoladi. To'g'ri tartibda esa 9 000 × 1.2 = 10 800, keyin 12 000.

Noto'g'riSELECT id,
       GREATEST(
         CASE tariff
           WHEN 'econom' THEN 6000 + 1500 * distance_km
           WHEN 'comfort' THEN 9000 + 2000 * distance_km
           ELSE 15000 + 3500 * distance_km
         END
         + 500 * GREATEST(wait_min - CASE tariff WHEN 'business' THEN 5 ELSE 3 END, 0),
         12000) * CASE WHEN night = 1 THEN 6 ELSE 5 END / 5 AS fare
FROM rides

(wait_min - 3) * 500 ni GREATEST(..., 0) siz yozsangiz, mijoz 1 daqiqa kutganda kutish haqi -1 000 bo'lib, narxdan ayiriladi.

Tungi qo'shimchani faqat asosiy narxga qo'llash ham xato: shart yig'indiga qo'shishni aytadi.

Boshqa yo'l

Ifoda takrorlanmasin desangiz, hisobni bosqichlarga bo'lib, hosila jadvallar bilan yozish mumkin (bu Subquery darsida). Har bosqichda ustunga nom beriladi va keyingisi shu nomdan foydalanadi:

SELECT id,
       CASE WHEN total < 12000 THEN 12000 ELSE total END AS fare
FROM (
  SELECT id,
         (base + CASE WHEN wait_min > free THEN (wait_min - free) * 500 ELSE 0 END)
           * CASE WHEN night = 1 THEN 6 ELSE 5 END / 5 AS total
  FROM (
    SELECT id, wait_min, night,
           CASE tariff
             WHEN 'econom' THEN 6000 + 1500 * distance_km
             WHEN 'comfort' THEN 9000 + 2000 * distance_km
             ELSE 15000 + 3500 * distance_km
           END AS base,
           CASE WHEN tariff = 'business' THEN 5 ELSE 3 END AS free
    FROM rides
  ) a
) b

Bu yechim ikkala bazada bir xil ishlaydi, chunki GREATEST va MAX o'rniga CASE yozilgan.
